text:
Irene Malik: Quick note before I write the RFC: we're exploring an install-time mini-CP for customers behind private VPCs. Main question: how do we scale revocation and attestations without DDOS-ing central CP?
Jon Park: Short TTLs help but at scale agents polling every 15s is rough. Need a differential model: only poll on epoch changes + exponential backoff for noise.
Sara Kim: Idea: central publishes a compact, signed epoch bitmap per-region (gzip+base64) that encodes which customer epochs changed. Agents fetch the small digest frequently (<10s) and only request full revocation when their bit flips. Saves CP CPU/bandwidth.
Tom Wu: Love that. But we need push for faster revokes during compromise: a pubsub fanout to regional relays that then nudge local agents. That avoids global polling spike.
Irene Malik: So hybrid: frequent tiny digest poll + push path for emergencies. Push goes to region relays (we already have them) which fan out to peered VPCs or brokers.
Jon Park: Bootstrapping: operator-run installer writes a signed join token to central which returns a region-assigned prefix and an initial epoch. Put the installer logs in customer audit bucket.
Sara Kim: Attestation options: cloud instance identity for cloud installs, TPM/virtTPM for on-prem. If attestation fails, agents fall back to central-only mode and alert.
Tom Wu: Operationally we must support a global kill-switch that increments epoch and marks mini-CPs stale so agents fail closed to central CP. That switch must be rate-limited and audited.
Irene Malik: Example digest flow (very small):
```
# central publishes: digest_v1 = base64(gzip(bitset))
agent GET /epoch-digest -> returns digest_v1
if verify(digest_v1) && bitset[tenant]==1: GET /revoke-list
```
Jon Park: Metrics to add: digest_fetch_latency, digest_size_bytes, stale_retries, push_fanout_latency. Also a simulation job to scale to 50k agents per-region.
Sara Kim: Security: signed digests with HSM key, replay protection via nonce. Also require agents use mTLS to relays and validate relay cert chain.
deploy-bot: Deploy: digest-push-prototype deployed to staging 2026-04-02T12:04:00Z
Tom Wu: OK. I'll draft the revocation appendix for the RFC with cost model, push/fallback architecture, and required ops playbooks (rollback, emergency revoke). Ping when draft is up. :thumbsup:
